summary: This week saw the Pentagon make an explicit push to access private UFO archives, signaling a shift toward consolidating nongovernmental UAP records under federal oversight. Journalist Ross Coulthart's reporting on congressional staffer disclosures continued to drive conversations about alleged recovered craft and beings, though verification remains elusive. Coverage also expanded into historical territory, with Liberation Times examining alleged Nazi connections to U.S. UAP programs and NewsNation probing whether the 1967 Malmstrom nuclear missile incident involved phenomenon capable of warping spacetime. Meanwhile, celebrity sightings and international incidents like Polish airspace breaches kept UAPs in the cultural conversation, though these typically lack the documentary specificity that moves disclosure forward on Capitol Hill.
